block.name: ecosystem_monitor: remove dead ces_monitor endpoint + create systemd service file
acceptance_criteria: ces_monitor entry removed from SERVICES dict in /home/josh/ecosystem-monitor/monitor.py

never: Do not edit any vendored file (ng_lite.py, ng_peer_bridge.py, ng_tract_bridge.py, ng_ecosystem.py, ng_autonomic.py, openclaw_adapter.py, ng_embed.py)
Do not run sudo — service installation is done manually by Josh after spec completes
Do not restart any running service

steps.description: Check that ces_monitor entry exists in monitor.py (idempotency check — skip patch if already removed)
Remove ces_monitor from SERVICES dict and add changelog entry to monitor.py

params.command:
python3 -c "
import re, sys

path = '/home/josh/ecosystem-monitor/monitor.py'
content = open(path).read()

# Remove ces_monitor block — port 8847 is dead since Apr 5 ecosystem restructure
pattern = r'    \"ces_monitor\":\s*\{[^}]+\},\n'
if re.search(pattern, content):
    content = re.sub(pattern, '', content)
    changed_services = True
else:
    changed_services = False

# Add changelog entry before closing sentinel
cl_sentinel = '# -------------------\n'
cl_entry = '# [2026-04-18] Codemine (BLK-EM-144) -- Remove defunct ces_monitor endpoint\n#   What: Removed ces_monitor (port 8847) from SERVICES dict\n#   Why:  Port 8847 dead since Apr 5 ecosystem restructure; spurious down-count in logs\n# -------------------\n'
if cl_entry not in content:
    content = content.replace(cl_sentinel, cl_entry)
    changed_cl = True
else:
    changed_cl = False

open(path, 'w').write(content)
print('PATCHED services=%s changelog=%s' % (changed_services, changed_cl))
"

steps.description: Verify ces_monitor dict entry is gone from monitor.py (check absence of URL 8847 in SERVICES context)
Write systemd service unit file to /home/josh/ecosystem-monitor/ for Josh to copy to /etc/systemd/system/

params.command:
python3 -c "
content = '''[Unit]
Description=Ecosystem Service Monitor -- Host Symbiosis Architecture v0.1
Documentation=https://github.com/greatnorthernfishguy-hub/
After=network.target
Wants=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=josh
WorkingDirectory=/home/josh/ecosystem-monitor
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /home/josh/ecosystem-monitor/monitor.py
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=30
StandardOutput=append:/home/josh/ecosystem-monitor/monitor.log
StandardError=append:/home/josh/ecosystem-monitor/monitor.log
Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
'''
open('/home/josh/ecosystem-monitor/ecosystem-monitor.service', 'w').write(content)
print('SERVICE_FILE_WRITTEN')
"

steps.description: Verify service file was written and contains expected content
Print summary of what was done and what Josh needs to run manually

params.command: echo 'BLK-EM-144 COMPLETE. monitor.py patched (ces_monitor removed). Service file at /home/josh/ecosystem-monitor/ecosystem-monitor.service. Josh: run these two commands to activate: sudo cp /home/josh/ecosystem-monitor/ecosystem-monitor.service /etc/systemd/system/ && sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl enable --now ecosystem-monitor'
